messages.subject: Project Cedar - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

As discussed, we'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter on the proposed acquisition of Harrowgate Precision Castings (codename Project Cedar). It's a Sheffield investment-castings business supplying aerospace and defence - founder-owned, with Penfold Growth Capital holding 30%.

Enterprise value is around £41.5m. We'd want to run it through a new Bidco, with W&I insurance. Can you send an engagement letter and get a team together?

Daniel

messages.subject: RE: Project Cedar - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Delighted - we'd love to act. James Osei will be my senior associate on this, with Elena Marchetti supporting. I'll have the engagement letter over to you tomorrow along with a confidentiality agreement to get signed with the target before we see the data room.

Provisional timetable: heads of terms this month, SPA drafting through March, aiming to exchange and complete in early May. That fits your fund timing?

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
